balls.text: All out for 113. Full on the stumps. Cummins lofts it down the ground but doesn't get the required distance. Starc makes no mistake at long-on this time
length outside off. Dragged towards long-on. Rejects the single
a slower length ball. Cummins goes for a slog across the line and gets beaten
a carrom ball outside off. Bhuvi defends it on the off side

Oh, what happened there?! A length ball around off, spinning in sharp. Unadkat looked to flick it on the leg side but got beaten. The ball hit the pad and after that, it looked like it went on to hit the stumps. Gurbaz was celebrating. Narine - well, he was as usual. Shreyas is having a chat with the umpires who is unmoved. And now they have reviewed it for the lbw. Three reds and Unadkat goes back
a carrom ball around off. Cummins works it towards cover-point
length ball on the stumps. Cummins moves across and flicks it behind square leg. Russell makes a sliding stop running to his right from deep square leg
Unadkat gloves a reverse sweep fine but the fielder is alert and dives to his left to make the stop
a length ball around off. Cummins works it towards midwicket. Unadkat was looking for the second but Rinku attacked the ball to keep it to one
a length ball outside off. Dabbed down to deep third

an excellent effort from Russell goes in vain. Was an on-pace delivery from Harshit, full outside off. Cummins scythed it over extra cover. Russell ran to his right from sweeper and completed the catch with a slide. But before he could throw the ball in, his knee collided with the boundary cushion
a slower short ball outside off. Cummins gets on the top of the bounce and hits it towards deep extra cover. SRH get to 100
another offcutter. On a good length outside off this time, and spins back to almost surprise Cummins. He chops it towards point
another slower ball, full outside off. Pushed straight to the cover fielder
a slower ball, full outside off. Unadkat drives it to the left of extra cover
Unadkat goes for the reverse hit but fails to middle it. It goes low towards short fine leg who dives forward but looks like it landed just in front of him
dropped by Starc at long-on. Cummins goes for the big hit but fails to nail it. Starc settles under it and looks all set to pouch it, but ends up dropping it
goes for the scoop. Unadkat shaped up for the scoop and seeing that, Shreyas from the slip moved towards the leg side. Only for Unadkat to miscue it towards the gully region
a length ball spinning in. Unadkat gets beaten on the inside edge and is hit on the pads. An appeal for lbw from the keeper but it was heading down
length ball on the pads. Flicked behind square leg

was a length ball down the leg side. Cummins attempted a reverse pull but the ball was far away from him. Gurbaz cannot do anything about it either. Not given a wide surprisingly but SRH do get four byes
a wicket maiden. Harshit ends the over with a short ball outside off. Once again Unadkat went for the pull. Once again he missed
full outside off. Looks to drive on the up and gets beaten
a bouncer outside off. Unadkat finds thin air with an ambitious pull

full and angling in, 141.1kph. Unadkat was looking to flick it away but gets beaten and is struck on the pads. An appeal for lbw but denied. Looked like it was going down. Gurbaz gestures the same but Harshit seems to have managed to convince his captain. It pitched around off but the impact itself was down the leg side
full around off. Driven firmly back towards the bowler
... and strikes first ball. The offcutter, 116.4kph, has done the trick. It was full outside off, Klaasen went for the big shot only to get an inside edge onto his stumps. Harshit is delighted
length ball outside off. Goes for the cut and gets beaten
length ball, pushed to long-off for one
length outside off. Goes back and hits it past the diving extra cover. But Ramandeep from deep cover puts in a sprint and a dive to keep it to two
quicker and spinning in to beat the inside edge and hit him on the pads. Was going down the leg side
goes for the scoop this time but Varun has erred down the leg side. Cummins, having moved outside off, misses and Gurbaz too fails to take it clean, conceding a bye
full around off. Cummins was initially looking to scoop it but seeing the length he reverse-scoops it between the keeper and short third. The fielder did put in a chase but in vain
a slower one, on the fuller side of good length and outside off. Cummins pushes it in the covers
short of length outside off. Cummins makes full use of the width and steers it behind point for four. Deep third had no chance of cutting it off

the Samad move doesn't work. He falls for 4. It was full and wide from Russell. Samad chases it with little footwork, gets an outside edge and Gurbaz takes a good catch diving to his right behind the stumps
the slower one gone wrong. Full and way down the leg side. Ignored by the batter
length ball around off. Pushed to long-on
length ball around off. Pushed towards long-on
a slower length ball on the stumps - 123.6kph. Tucked away in front of square leg for a couple
length ball outside off. Punched towards sweeper cover

this was on the cards - Shahbaz never looked confident against Varun. It's fuller around off from Varun, Shahbaz goes for a sweep only to top-edge it to short fine leg, where Narine paddles back to take it comfortably
length ball around off. Shahbaz is looking tentative against Varun. Manages to deflect it towards short third but no run
length ball on the stumps, defended awkwardly
length ball around off. Goes back and cuts it towards wide long-off. Only one
length outside off. Goes for the cut but mistimes it into the ground towards extra cover
another hard-length delivery that hurries the batter. Shahbaz goes for the pull and gets a top edge that flies over the keeper's head for a six
length outside off. Goes for the cut and gets beaten
a bouncer angling across the batter. Left alone
length ball around off. Tucked away towards deep square leg for a couple

Markram departs! A length ball around off from Russell, good bounce. Markram goes for the pull but it hits him high on the bat. Ends up hitting it straight into the lap of Starc at long-on. SRH 62 for 5
length ball on the stumps. Swatted towards deep midwicket
On a length but a touch wide and Markram cuts to deep cover for a run
Knuckle ball on middle, Markram pushes back to the bowler
Offbreak that spins back sharply back into Markram, who gets hit on the pad but the ball was going down leg
Fired in at 94.2kph on middle and leg, he gets it down to long on
A tad short just outside off, he stays back and thrashes to deep cover
Fullish-length ball at 94.1kph on off stump, he eases it down to long-on
Slower offcutters galore in that over. Was a tad short and wide though as Klaasen cuts to deep cover
110.8kph slower ball on off stump. This one certainly gripped and spun back into Klaasen on off. He pushes to the right of the bowler who puts in a dive
Slower offcutter again at 115.7kph, was bowled fuller and outside off. Klaasen drives on the up towards mid-off
Slower offcutter at 113.4kph outside off. He stays back and gets it to deep cover
Slower length ball outside off, he pushes towards the off side for a run
Edged for four! Was a length ball just outside off stump. There was a little bit of nip on that and Klaasen, who was legside of the ball gets a thick edge past the keeper.
95.2kph flatter length ball outside off, he punches to deep cover
Fired on a length outside off, he scythes it to deep cover, all along the ground this time around
Flicked uppishly and perilously close to midwicket. The ball sticks on the surface on middle as Markram is early into his shot. Is lucky the ball did not go to hand
Flatter, 95.2kph and on a length on middle and leg. Klaasen pushes to long on
Flatter outside off, he stays back and pushes uppishly past cover. Hands on heads for a lot of the KKR fielders.
On a good length outside off, he cuts but can't beat point

Three slower balls, followed by a 146kph peach and Nitish is a goner! On a length just outside off, seaming away from Nitish, who looks to force it through the offside. Gets a faint tickle with Gurbaz doing the rest. Rana is pumped and KKR are firmly on top!
A third slower ball on the bounce. Offcutter that grips on the surface. Nitish waits for the ball and smashes to extra cover
Another slower ball, 113.8kph outside off, Markram mistimes towards the offside for a run
Slower length ball deceives Markram all ends up. 114.1kph length ball that pitches outside off, grips on the surface and moves back into Markram, who can't lay a bat on that
That was short and wide again, but Markram fails to reach it. Called a wide.
On a length just outside off, he opens the face of his blade and pats it towards deep third
Short, wide, thrashed! Gets into position nice and early and smacks Rana past point with some authority
Slower length ball outside off, he pushes to the left of Shreyas Iyer at mid-off for a run to end a 17-run over

A hit-me ball and Nitish takes maximum toll. Short of a length ball down leg, he gets into position by getting inside the line and helps him over short fine leg and as it turns out over the ropes as well.
Slower short of a length ball outside off. Nitish thinks of a pull, but bails out eventually.

Oh, Markram had to put in the dive to make it home. Close, so close. Length on off, he pushes to mid-off firmly and sets off. Iyer collects cleanly and fires a flat throw, but doesn't get a direct hit. Think Markram was struggling there.
And again! Short and wide outside off, Markram stands tall and hammers him in the same region with a little more power. The ball bounces juuust short of the boundary hoarding.
THRASHED! Short, wide and there to be punished. Makram cuts it up and over cover for a four
Strays the length ball way past the tramline outside off. Called a wide.
Fuller-length ball angling away from Nitish outside off, who watches closely and shoulders arms
Fuller but well outside off stump. Nitish can't get any bat on it
On a length outside off, he gets across and slaps it to deep cover
Good length ball angling away from Nitish who opens the face of the bat and guides to deep third

Wicket no. 3 for KKR and SRH's top order is in disarray! On a length angling away from Tripathi just outside off, he was looking to flick this away. Gets a big top-edge that balloons straight up. Ramandeep settles under the ball just in front of square leg and takes a comfortable catch. Starc has two wickets inside the powerplay.
Angles the length ball away from Tripathi well outside off. He looks to go up and over cover, connects at thin air
Gets the inswinger on point again around middle as Markram defends back to the bowler
Good length ball just on off, he stands tall and pushes to the off side for a quick run
Fuller but down leg once more, called a wide
The ball is definitely swinging hoops. Tripathi jumps down the track looking to flay it away through the offside but is done in by the swing. The ball started outside off and ended just over off.
On a length on middle and leg, he works it towards midwicket for a quick run
A sharp inswinger to Markram now. Length ball that starts outside off and meets Markram around off and middle. He defends towards mid-off
On-pace length ball just outside off, he pushes towards point for a quick run
Slower ball goes awry. Down leg stump, called a wide
Tripathi is not going to die wondering. Attempts the scoop by shuffling across to his off stump. He doesn't connect, but the ball was down leg, nevertheless.
Fullish length ball again on the stumps, he pushes to mid-on
So close to another one! Fuller homing in on middle. Markram was looking to flick it away, instead gets a thick inside-edge onto his pad

Edged but past the lone slip for a four. Heart in the mouth stuff. Was very similar to how he got out in the Qualifier 2. Fuller, shaping away from Markram well outside off. He throws his hands at it, gets a thick edge and a few runs
Length ball on middle and leg again, Markram defends
On a length on middle and leg, he works it to the on-side for a run
Length on the pads, Tripathi flicks it neatly to the fine leg fence. Important four runs

Head is gone for a first ball duck! The swing is doing the job for the KKR bowlers. Arora gets the ball on a length on leg stump and and gets it to shape sharply away from Head. He stays leg side of the ball and can only get a thin edge to Gurbaz.
Slower good length ball on middle stump, he works it away towards deep backward square leg for a run. Was bowled at 122.4kph.
Sharp length ball on middle and leg. He misses the flick and the ball catches his pads rolling away to the leg side. Gurbaz hares across, but can't prevent two extra runs
Length just on off, he backs away looking to go up and over, but can only mistime to mid-off
Another good length ball outside off, the ball hits the higher part of his bat towards slip
Ooh, edged but falls short of the keeper. On a good length outside off, he looks to defend, gets an edge but to his credit played with soft hands as the ball fell short of Gurbaz
Length ball around off stump, he defends towards the off side

Oh, my word! Ball of the tournament? That's what big players do, deliver balls like these when it matters the most. It was a length ball that pitched just on middle and tailed away at the last moment, breaching Abhishek's defences and catching the top of off stump. What a jaffa!

Oh, dear! Abhishek has gone back for two and almost run himself out. Was a fuller length ball angling outside off. He scythes to the right of Ramandeep at deep third. A wayward throw comes in and Gurbaz can't hit the stumps. Abhishek survives
Mistimed on the bounce to cover. Was a good length ball angling well away from Abhishek, who gets it off the cue end of the bat to Russell
Another play and a miss. Was a length ball well outside off that continued to shape away from him. Abhishek can't get a connection
Swing and a miss! A hint of away movement on the length ball away from Abhishek outside off. He reaches for it and misses

A third IPL title for KKR, their first since 2014. Full and way outside off. Venkatesh looks to fetch it from there, gets an inside edge into the ground, perhaps deflecting off his shoe, to beat the keeper. The single takes KKR across the line
scores are level. A length ball around off. Shreyas drops it on the off side and takes a single
dropped. Full on the stumps. Venkatesh sweeps it in the air behind square leg. Tripathi charges in, puts in the dive but ends up dropping the low chance
a length ball outside off. Goes back and cuts it towards sweeper cover. Gets to his fifty
a length ball spinning in. Helped towards backward square leg
length ball around off. Goes back and pulls it over midwicket. Only a single
backs away towards the leg side before going for the fine reverse hit. Misses again
goes for the reverse hit but fails to connect and gets hit on the body
length outside off. Venkatesh pulls it but fails to middle it. Falls safely over midwicket for a couple
and he opens his account. Full delivery and he reverse-sweeps it past short third for four

given lbw! But Gurbaz has reviewed it straightaway. It was full on the stumps. Gurbaz moved across to sweep it fine. Looks like he missed it and the ball went past the leg stump, perhaps brushing the pad on its way and beating the keeper to the boundary. Even if it's not out, KKR will not get any runs as the ball would be deemed dead right after the umpire raised the finger. The third umpire says the ball-tracking and the UltraEdge is down, so he stays with on-field decision. Gurbaz isn't happy
down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball, and launches it over the bowler's head. KKR just 12 away now
Shahbaz follows Gurbaz who was backing away. Defended in the end
goes for the reverse pull but the ball pitch on the leg stump and turns to it Venkatesh on the pads. He picks up a leg-bye
full outside off. Drags it towards deep midwicket for a couple
Slower back of a length ball outside off, but this one just sits up to be smacked. Gurbaz waits for it and hammers it to the deep midwicket fence
Fuller, on pace ball on off stump. He lofts this to long-on and calls for two again. Not on this time, though
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he thumps this to the right of long off and calls for two immediately.
Takes all the pace off the ball. Slower back of a length ball on off. Iyer is way too early into his pull and misses
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he pushes towards point for another quick run
Slower length ball outside off, he slaps it to long on for a run
Flatter just outside off, he pushes to point
Jumps down the track does Iyer looking to mow this one across the line. Gets hit on the pad with the ball going towards the square leg region
Shortens the length but the line is outside off as Gurbaz works it to deep midwicket

They keep going! This will be over in a flash. Slows this one up outside off. Gurbaz gets across and inside the line of the ball to sweep it over short fine leg. The ball hits the boundary cushion on the full
Beats the batter, beats the keeper...four byes the result. Angles the ball into Gurbaz who backs away and is beaten. Klaasen can't get around too
Length ball just outside off, he pushes towards point
On a length on off, he works it to midwicket and takes a quick run
Fuller on middle and leg, he whips it to long-on
I is all going Venkatesh Iyer's way! Pacy length ball on middle. He looks to wallops it over deep midwicket, gets a thick outside edge that flies to the right of short third
SMASHED! Slower length ball but that was on his pads, right in his hitting arc. He gets across and flicks this miles over deep backward square leg for a huge six
Banged in short now just outside off, he swivels and pulls into the deep midwicket region for four more. Iyer is in some hurry
Slapped past point and he gets a four. Good length ball on the stumps, he backs away and cuts with some authority
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he works this to midwicket
Another quick length ball on off stump, Gurbaz pushes towards cover
Pacy bouncer that hurries Gurbaz. He is early into his pull and can't get a bat on it
Sharp length ball on leg stump, Iyer pushes to long-on for a run
Loses his shape altogether on the slower length ball outside off. Ends up mistiming it to long-on
Gurbaz backs away and Cummins follows him but the short of a length ball is on his hips. Gurbaz gets rapped on the glove and the ball goes to the vacant fine leg fence
Short of a length ball down leg, he helps it to deep backward square leg's right for a run
Length ball on middle and leg, he whips it to deep backward square leg

Nitish almost conjures a stunning run out. Slower good length ball on the stumps. He backs away and pushes the ball to the right of extra cover, where Nitish dives, and shies at the non-striker's stumps being off-balanced. Gurbaz dives but would have been gone with a direct hit
On a length on middle stump, defended back to the bowler
Attempted bouncer, but this one was a touch too high. Called a wide on height.
Jumps down the track looking to mow it across the line. Misses and is struck on the pad
Edged between first slip and short third. He couldn't have placed it better there Gurbaz. On a length shaping just a touch away from Gurbaz. He gets a thick outside edge and places it to perfection
Pushes the length ball down leg first up. Called a wide.

Excellent fielding saves two runs. Was a length ball on the pads again as Iyer flicked past short fine leg. The fielder at deep backward square leg hares to his right, puts in a dive to save some runs. Still, 20 off that Bhuvi over
Sharp inswinger from Bhuvi raps Gurbaz on the gloves on off dropping close to the off stump. Venkatesh Iyer is quick to react and takes a run
Good length ball on off, he pushes towards cover for a quick run
He goes again! This is HUGE. On a length on middle and leg. He shimmies down, gives himself room and deposits the ball in the first tier of Chepauk straight down the ground
PUMPED! Was on a length on off stump. Iyer wastes no time in jumping down the track and thumping this over the bowler's head for a six
Flicked fine, flicked for four! Wayward length ball on Iyer's pads who glances it nonchalantly to the fine leg fence
Gurbaz shimmies down the track but Cummins sees that and digs one short. Gurbaz has no option but to duck under
Up and over! On a length on off stump, Gurbaz backs away, gives himself room and lofts Cummins over mid-off. Did not get all of it, but enough to clear the fielder.
Keeps it in that channel just on off stump. Gurbaz can't free his arms and defends back towards Cummins
Length ball angling back into Gurbaz who stands tall and defends
Wayward start for him. Pushes the length ball way down leg, and Klaasen does well to save a few extra runs

Six and out! Cummins strikes with his second ball.  Length ball on leg stump, he cramps Narine for room. He takes a step outside leg stump and looks to work it away, only to get a big top edge. Shahbaz runs in from deep midwicket and takes the catch.
And he is away with a huge six! Dropped short on middle stump, he swivels and pulls miles over deep midwicket
Length just outside off, Gurbaz pushes towards point and sets off only to be sent back by Narine
Another length ball shaping away from Gurbaz outside off, who this time shoulders arms
Beaten again. Fuller in length shaping just a touch away from Gurbaz who feels for the ball and is lucky to not get an edge on that
Strays outside the tramline this time around and Gurbaz shoulders arms. Called a wide. Klaasen isn't impressed but Bhuvi says, it was fine
Good length ball with a hint of away movement outside off. Gurbaz pushes towards cover
Shorter and wider, and Gurbaz is away. He cuts it away hard and to the right of deep third away. That sped away in a flash
Beaten first up. Gurbaz shimmies down the track but Bhuvi keeps the ball on a length shaping just a touch away from the batter who gets no connection on it
